XDOCUMENTO.Titolo: Engine fault warning light comes on, with vehicle functioning correctly
XDOCUMENTO.InfoDoc: INJECTION | SOLENOID VALVE | VARIATOR | PHASE | VALVE | ELECTRIC | ELECTRONIC | P0009 | P0011 | LIGHTS UP | ON | MIL | YELLOW | YELLOW | CONTROL | FILTER | FILTER | DIRTY | SMUDGED | DIRTY |

XCAPITOLO.Corpo:
Reliability rating key

* low level : Reported by a garage mechanic; fault case not recorded by the manufacturer.

** medium level : Widespread occurrence of the fault, confirmed by service technicians and independent repairers.

*** high level : Confirmed fault, with a high degree of ‘recurrence’ reported by the manufacturer.

• System: Injection

  • Component: Variable valve timing solenoid valve

  • Fault: The vehicle’s engine fault light is illuminated, whilst the engine continues to run smoothly

  • Errors detected by the on-board diagnostics:
    • P0009 (Engine timing/control system, bank 2 – Generic fault)
    • P0011 (Camshaft 1 position/phase, bank 1 – Advance angle)
  • Cause: Phase-varying solenoid valve strainer, clogged

• Action: Check the condition of the filter in the variable valve timing solenoid; if necessary, replace the solenoid itself

  • Procedure: - -

  • Note: In this case, the variable valve timing solenoid valve was replaced, as its filter screen was found to be clogged; to resolve the fault permanently, the variable valve timing unit itself was also replaced.
    The component is located at the top of the engine compartment, on the passenger side, connected to the valve cover.
